<thought>Based on the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense peak is at m/z 100.0524. This matches the [M+H]⁺ ion of a molecule with neutral monoisotopic mass ≈ 99.045 Da. The isotopic pattern (≈5 % M+1) indicates about five carbon atoms (≈5 × 1.1 %). A formula that fits these constraints is C₅H₇O₂ (neutral mass 99.0451 Da; [M+H]⁺ = 100.0524 Da). No other hetero‑atoms are required. Therefore the molecular formula is C5H7O2.</thought>
<final_answer>C5H7O2</final_answer>
